item.title: College's Role in the American Dream Is Being Reevaluated
item.description: The value of a college degree is increasingly questioned, prompting a broader reassessment of its place in achieving success.

item.title: AI prompts college students to reconsider their majors
item.description: Students and parents are seeking college majors that remain relevant in an AI-driven world. AI is altering the skills employers value.

item.title: American travel desire reaches record levels
item.description: Data from the International Trade Administration and a chart by Sara Wise/Axios show that despite U.S. policy distancing from Europe, Americans are traveling more.

item.title: Luigi Mangione admits to stalking and killing UnitedHealthcare CEO
item.description: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty in federal court to stalking charges related to the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.
